detail.longDescription: (im on windows 10 and i use VScode) i run a subprocess using the subprocess module. but it closes if i kill the parent process (whether i kill it with VScode or with os.kill(os.getpid()) ) I TRIED EVERYTHING and nothing works I tried: subprocess.Popen("SnippingTool.exe", shell=True) subprocess.Popen("SnippingTool.exe", start_new_session=True) subprocess.Popen("SnippingTool.exe", creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP) subprocess.Popen("SnippingTool.exe", creationflags=subprocess.DETACHED_PROCESS) and all the combinations of these, but nothing worked
